title: Zoho Books Autoscan: Turn Receipts Into Bills and Expenses Automatically
headline: Receipts in, *no typing*
source_line: Source: Zoho Books help - Documents and Autoscan (checked 17 Nov 2026)
description:
Stop typing receipts by hand: in Zoho Books open Documents > Files, agree to the terms and click Enable Autoscan. Upload files, snap receipts with the Zoho Books mobile app, or email them to your organization's unique Documents inbox address. Select a scanned file, click Add to, and choose a bill or an expense - details like the date, amount and merchant are pre-filled. Autoscan works in 15 languages and is available on all plans; after the free scans are used up, a paid add-on (50 autoscans a month) is needed.

Sources (checked 17 Nov 2026):
- Zoho Books help - Documents (Autoscan): https://www.zoho.com/books/help/documents/documents.html
- Zoho Books FAQ - Enable Autoscan: https://www.zoho.com/uk/books/kb/bills/upload-bill-button-not-present.html

lines: Still typing receipts into your books by hand? Zoho Books can read them for you.
It's called Autoscan, and it captures the details from the documents you upload or email in.
Open Documents in the left sidebar, then Files.
Agree to the terms, and click Enable Autoscan.
Upload files, snap receipts with the Zoho Books mobile app, or email them to your organization's own Documents inbox address.
Then select a scanned file, click Add to, and choose a bill or an expense.
The date, amount and merchant are already filled in. It works in fifteen languages, and after the free scans, there's a paid add-on.
